summary: AI semantic integration debt
rationale: Stable owners and bounded contexts reduce repeated semantic reconstruction.

summary: Current, historical and supersession drift
rationale: Currentness and supersession need explicit transitions.

summary: Programme and owner discoverability gap
rationale: A bounded change owner must be directly discoverable.

summary: Issue chronology becomes restart context
rationale: Work history must not be required to recover current state.

summary: Bounded work and programme closability gap
rationale: Results must return consequences to the whole system.

summary: Durable decision promotion is incomplete
rationale: Durable state already has a repository-first owner; WP1 traces it.

summary: Requirements namespace contains heterogeneous roles
rationale: Classification precedes physical migration.

summary: Active and persisted knowledge are insufficiently separated
rationale: Persistence must not imply default current context.

summary: Derived-state reification
rationale: Views must derive from canonical owners.

summary: Review premise inheritance
rationale: Trace helps but does not establish independent epistemic evidence.

summary: Local correctness can be globally misframed
rationale: Local PASS must return to the parent/system boundary.

summary: Minimality and adequacy bias
rationale: Sufficiency precedes simplification.

summary: Parent, child and return semantics are easy to lose
rationale: WP1 uses the admitted bounded-change and whole-return contract.

summary: Derived operational views are useful but risky
rationale: Read models follow currentness owners.

summary: Exact-head and post-mutation assurance matters
rationale: Qualification must identify the exact tested tree.

summary: Authority laundering from descriptive state
rationale: Resource, metadata and technical state do not create authority.

summary: #225 positive scholarly end-to-end fixture remains unproven
rationale: EKCP must preserve this separate scholarly residual.

summary: Orientation surfaces can become stale
rationale: README remains navigation and points to canonical owners.

summary: Repository-first is stronger than persisted somewhere
rationale: Durable state is persisted in its intended repository owner.

summary: Human can be used as relay or router
rationale: Routine continuation must not become a Human transport burden.

summary: Authorization is not informed decision readiness
rationale: A decision surface must expose stage and consequence.

summary: Development stages become solution-shaped too early
rationale: Requirements, design and implementation remain distinct.

summary: Context economy can become context starvation
rationale: Progressive disclosure must preserve authority and uncertainty.

summary: Relations are useful but graph runtime is unproven
rationale: Use minimal correct relations; retain graph runtime as a trigger-based option.

summary: Genericity is not distribution
rationale: No package or portal is justified by current evidence.

summary: Generic-Fit remains incomplete across structures
rationale: Qualification needs materially different fixtures.

summary: System-development developer bootstrap is weak
rationale: One current entry path and local check are required.

summary: Engineering CI does not validate its own IA
rationale: Fitness follows stable contracts.

summary: Rich-audit insight can disappear while source persists
rationale: Coverage completeness must precede finding disposition claims.

summary: Proposed trace references are underspecified
rationale: Stable reference classes and anchors are required.

summary: Context-profile applicability is underspecified
rationale: Applicability provenance must remain explicit.

summary: Configuration shape lacks transition semantics
rationale: Currentness cannot be latest-wins.

summary: Central TSV representation was selected before dry-run
rationale: WP1 proves the hybrid over real brownfield inputs before movement.

summary: Decision brief can be complete yet incomprehensible
rationale: Decision readiness requires comprehension validation.

summary: Audit coverage completeness must itself be proved
rationale: Registered findings alone cannot prove source-level completeness.

summary: Architecture-decision visibility is underpowered
rationale: ADR rationale is distinct from accepted DECISIONS.md authority.

summary: Readiness is activity-relative
rationale: Ready-for-design and ready-for-implementation are different claims.

summary: Decision-readiness jargon can hide meaning
rationale: Human-facing wording must preserve operative scope.

summary: Anti-regression can become a meta-loop
rationale: Safeguards must permit bounded work that is ready for its declared activity.

summary: Prompt and work-instruction is a real information class
rationale: Prompt capability remains thin and bounded.

summary: Human overview and Agent context are different products
rationale: Both views derive from the same owners with different disclosure.

summary: The bugwave lacked a visible bounded work surface
rationale: The programme and child issues expose current work metadata.

summary: Human feedback is need or failure evidence, not automatic authority
rationale: Existing authority boundaries control the general rule; real-use validation remains.

summary: Persisted or reconciled learning is not automatically operationally enforced
rationale: Assurance language must match the actually tested enforcement level.

summary: Simplification or migration can delete useful cognitive or review functions
rationale: Migration must test discoverability and reviewer function, not only bytes.
